title: Dehing Patkai National Park
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Dehing Patkai National Park, in Upper Assam, is a lowland tropical rainforest, often called the Amazon of the East. It became a national park in 2021.

Wildlife

The park is home to hoolock gibbons (India's only ape), elephants, clouded leopards, hornbills and many orchids and butterflies, in dense evergreen forest.

Threats and protection

Dehing Patkai's forests have been threatened by coal mining and encroachment, and its national park status was a major conservation win for Assam's rainforest.
